correctness.rationale: Under gamma>0, lambda>0, D>=0, iid independent Poisson kicks with E|J|^4 finite, the stationary convolution exists in L4. Its fourth cumulant is lambda E[J^4]/(4 gamma). Writing centered Y_t=qY_0+eta with independent, mean-zero eta and variance v(1-q^2), exact chronological fourth moment expansions give Delta=-kappa4 q(1-q^2). The cubic has its unique positive peak at q=1/sqrt(3). Independent stationary reversible additive observations cancel in the difference of fourth joint cumulants. The general mixed-cumulant hierarchy follows from multilinearity; higher moments explicitly require E|J|^n finite. All claims have analytic proofs and the accompanying standard-library program passes generator/quadrature/innovation checks; no finite test is treated as an infinite proof.
